source_refs.note: Topic 20.4 with Quick Check 20.7, printed pages 65-66. The printed chlorination of methylbenzene (one methylbenzene + 2Cl2 giving both isomers + 2HCl) is not balanced; noted under the figure.

blocks.text: Any group attached with benzene ring affects the electrophilic substitution reaction and determines the orientation of the substitution. There are two ways in which various substituents “direct” electrophilic aromatic substitution of incoming electrophile to benzene ring.
